s='def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    known = [(i, row[0]) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]
    period = n
    for p in range(1, n + 1):
        vals = {}
        if all((i % p not in vals or vals.setdefault(i % p, c) == c) for i, c in known):
            period = p
            break
    vals = {}
    for i, c in known: vals[i % period] = c
    default = known[0][1] if known else 0
    return [[vals.get(i % period, default)] * len(row) for i, row in enumerate(grid)]
